responsibility: Owns the append-only trajectory events from which position is derived.
failure_boundary: fail_closed — events cannot be amended or deleted, seq is unique, and no column stores a current position that could drift from the events
recovery_behavior: Position is recomputed from the highest-seq event on every read, so an interrupted run resumes with the last durably recorded step as the position and no reconciliation step is required
replacement_contract: A replacement must keep macro and micro events in one ordered append-only sequence and must not store a position field that duplicates the latest event
evidence_produced: ordered trajectory_events rows with per-event detail
the single highest-seq row from which you-are-here is derived
